actor: DRAM capacity planner, high-bandwidth memory supplier
job: Routing wafer starts into HBM4 base die and stacks rather than converting that capacity back to commodity DRAM output.
outcome: A bit mix that stays weighted to HBM through the ramp, leaving reported DRAM volume short of what spot pricing would reward.
motivation: Contracted HBM volume is already committed, so redirecting those bits to chase DRAM pricing would break the agreements that bought forward visibility.

task.who: Fab capacity planning and product-mix planning teams
task.what: Allocate wafer starts to HBM4 over commodity DRAM
task.where: Quarterly fab loading and product-mix planning cycle
task.why: Committed HBM volume cannot chase a rising spot price
task.how: Wafer-start allocation model against long-term agreement volumes

actor: HBM4 production ramp manager, advanced memory packaging
job: Scaling HBM4 stacking output from first shipments to volume across the second half, on the schedule the supplier has already described.
outcome: HBM4 shipping in volume on the published schedule, so the allocation described at the quarter's results continues rather than being quietly unwound.
motivation: A ramp already announced to customers and investors is far more costly to slow down than it is to finish.

task.who: Advanced packaging and HBM assembly engineering teams
task.what: Scale HBM4 stack output to volume production
task.where: Advanced packaging lines and back-end assembly capacity
task.why: An announced ramp is costlier to slow than to finish
task.how: Through-silicon-via stacking capacity and yield ramp milestones

actor: Investor relations disclosure lead, memory supplier
job: Drafting the results presentation and call script that names allocation, not demand, as the reason reported figures sit below a DRAM-cycle model.
outcome: The supplier's own disclosure restating the allocation argument and the long-term agreements, rather than a customer or a reporter describing the choice for it.
motivation: The allocation only reads as deliberate strategy if the company keeps saying so in the venue where it is on the record.

task.who: Investor relations and corporate communications disclosure team
task.what: Restate the allocation argument in quarterly results disclosure
task.where: Quarterly earnings presentation, conference call and regulatory filing
task.why: The claim needs the company on its own record
task.how: Earnings deck, call script and Korean regulatory disclosure filing

actor: Long-term supply agreement manager, memory sales planning
job: Extending and executing the roughly ten multi-year supply agreements that commit HBM volume and underwrite visibility into AI infrastructure spending beyond 2027.
outcome: Committed volume large enough that redirecting bits toward spot DRAM pricing would mean breaching contracts, making the allocation structural rather than discretionary.
motivation: Contracted visibility is the asset the supplier sells to investors, and it disappears the moment contracted bits get diverted elsewhere.

task.who: Sales planning, contract management and legal counsel
task.what: Extend multi-year HBM supply agreements with major customers
task.where: Customer contract negotiations and annual volume commitment reviews
task.why: Committed contract volume makes the allocation structural, not discretionary
task.how: Multi-year committed-volume and pricing agreement templates

actor: HBM4E customer qualification engineer, memory product engineering
job: Moving the HBM4E samples already sent to major customers through qualification so the next generation keeps consuming allocated bits into 2027.
outcome: Customer qualification sign-off that carries the HBM roadmap past HBM4, so no window opens for capacity to return to commodity DRAM.
motivation: A qualified successor part books the allocation further forward, while a stalled one would hand the reversal argument to critics.

task.who: Product engineering and customer quality assurance teams
task.what: Drive HBM4E samples through customer qualification testing
task.where: Joint qualification programmes with accelerator and system customers
task.why: A qualified successor part books the allocation further forward
task.how: Sample qualification test plans and reliability sign-off gates

actor: Capital expenditure planning lead, memory supplier finance
job: Setting the next-year investment plan so spending follows HBM capacity and advanced packaging rather than conversion back to commodity DRAM output.
outcome: An approved capital plan that funds the HBM path, making a swing back toward DRAM pricing expensive to execute in 2027.
motivation: Once capital is committed to HBM capacity, reversing the allocation costs more than absorbing another quarter of consensus shortfall.

task.who: Corporate finance and capital investment planning committee
task.what: Approve next-year capital plan weighted to HBM capacity
task.where: Annual capital expenditure planning and board approval cycle
task.why: Committed capital makes reversing the allocation expensive to execute
task.how: Annual capital budget review and equipment procurement commitments
